description:
Mikhail Malhotra-Halverson are lean and angular, all sharp edges and visible tension. At 42, scars map their face like a transit diagram of bad decisions and worse luck. The chrome is visible â€” cortical bomb (employer installed, removed by street doc, scar tissue remains) â€” and they make no effort to hide it.

They used to be somebody else, in another city, with another name â€” that person is officially dead, and Mikhail Malhotra-Halverson plans to keep it that way. They work as a combat medic out of Dockside, taking contracts that match their skills and their risk tolerance, which are higher than most people consider healthy.

In a city full of people who talk about what they'll do, Mikhail Malhotra-Halverson are one of the ones who actually does it.

core_fears: Becoming obsolete as augmentation technology outpaces their chrome
Losing their edge to age â€” the body slows before the mind accepts it
Going cyberpsycho â€” losing the boundary between human and machine

Ritual â€” follows the same pre-job routine every time, superstition as structure
blind_spots: Assumes their skill set is more transferable than it actually is
Assumes everyone has an angle because they always have an angle

psychology.secret: Erkin Santos-Owusu once worked for corporate intelligence and still has a handler who calls in favors. Each favor erodes what's left of their independence.

example_lines: "Hold still. This is going to hurt and I don't care."
"I can keep you alive through almost anything. What I can't do is make you grateful."

Erkin Santos-Owusu discovers a job they completed last year was a setup for something much larger and much worse

narrative_function: Erkin Santos-Owusu functions as a connector â€” their work puts them in contact with multiple factions, classes, and agendas. Stories involving them naturally cross boundaries between districts, tiers, and moral categories.

daily_life: Between contracts, maintains a cover identity â€” mundane work, mundane hours, mundane neighbors. The transition from civilian to runner and back requires a conscious effort that gets easier with practice and more disturbing with self-awareness.

old injury that flares under specific conditions

Will not take contracts against children or families â€” the line is hard and non-negotiable

escalation_ladder: 1. Assess â€” read the situation, identify threats and advantages
2. Negotiate â€” try to find a solution that doesn't cost ammunition
3. Intimidate â€” make the cost of conflict clear

interpersonal_modes.employers: Guarded respect. They pay, the job gets done. Anything beyond that is liability.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Competitive but reliable. Will challenge decisions but never abandon the team.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Default suspicion, scaled by context. Everyone is a potential threat until proven otherwise.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Cold and efficient. Emotion is a liability in combat. The response is mechanical until the threat is resolved.

stress_responses.low: Channels it into preparation â€” checks gear, reviews plans, contacts sources.
stress_responses.medium: Physical agitation â€” pacing, fidgeting, compulsive equipment checks.
stress_responses.high: Hyper-focused tunnel vision. Peripheral concerns disappear. Only the threat exists.
stress_responses.critical: Berserker clarity. Everything becomes simple: survive. Deal with the rest later. The simplicity is almost peaceful.

contradictions: Claims not to care about reputation but monitors what people say about them obsessively
Claims to work only for money but regularly takes underpriced jobs that serve personal justice
Values loyalty intensely but has betrayed someone in the past to survive
habits: Maintains a dead drop with emergency supplies in three separate districts
Sleeps with one hand on a weapon â€” has done this for so long it's not deliberate anymore
Carries a specific caliber round as a lucky charm â€” has never fired it
breaking_points: Discovering their employer deliberately sent them into a death trap
Complete isolation â€” cut off from network, contacts, and purpose simultaneously

physical_description.heritage: Striking polyphonic phenotype from balanced tri-continental ancestry: Eastern European (31.9%), Southeast Asian (31.2%), and South Asian (27.1%) create the primary genetic signature, with smaller contributions from Hispanic/Latin American (6.0%) and Sub-Saharan African (3.8%) adding warmth and complexity. The result is a face that resists easy categorization â€” high, prominent cheekbones with the angular structure of Eastern European ancestry combined with the eye shape and subtle epicanthal fold characteristics of Southeast Asian genetics. South Asian genetics contribute warm golden undertones and slight facial breadth, while African ancestry adds luminosity and depth to skin tone. Central Asian influences visible in cheekbone prominence and jawline width. This is a face marked by genetic heterogeneity: neither pale nor deep brown, but a warm, luminous golden-brown that shifts subtly with light.
physical_description.build: Lean and angular with visible corded muscle â€” the build of someone who moves constantly and eats inconsistently. Minimal body fat, pronounced shoulders and forearms from surgical precision work and field extraction tasks.
physical_description.hair_style: Pulled back tight, practical â€” either in a short braid or secured with a single band. No vanity in it.
physical_description.eye_color: Chrome iris rings over dark brown â€” cybernetic overlay with visible LED micro-circuitry
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm golden-brown with luminous depth from balanced Eastern European, Southeast Asian, South Asian, and African genetic blend â€” rich and complex, catching light with subtle golden undertones
physical_description.complexion: Angular face with high, prominent cheekbones showing Eastern European structure combined with slightly narrower eye contours and subtle epicanthal fold characteristics from Southeast and South Asian ancestry. Sharp jawline with subtle width from Central Asian genetics. Heavily scarred â€” not from age but from impact trauma and surgical revision. Skin shows old burn marks along the right side of the neck (cortical bomb removal site). No grooming pretense; scars are left untattooed and visible. Perpetually tired eyes with the characteristic intensity of someone whose vision is partially cybernetic.
distinguishing_marks: Jagged scar running from right temple to jaw â€” pale and raised, approximately 12cm, from blunt force trauma
Network of fine white scars across both palms and inner forearms â€” surgical and field trauma overlay
Cortical bomb removal scar: thick ridge of pale tissue along right side of neck and upper shoulder, roughly 8cm, with visible subcutaneous irregularities from street-doc extraction
Small burn scarring on left wrist in a precise geometric pattern â€” possibly from equipment malfunction
Faint suture marks along both temples where cybernetic eye integration was completed
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Cybernetic eyes with chrome iris rings and visible LED circuitry around the orbital sockets â€” pupils glow faintly amber during thermal mode activation. Cortical bomb removal scarring is impossible to hide; the raised tissue and color mismatch draw immediate attention. No attempt to conceal either modification.
physical_description.posture_movement: Economical and precise â€” moves like someone trained in field medicine under fire. Weight shifts are calculated. Hands are steady and rarely still. Default posture is slightly forward, ready. Eyes track multiple points simultaneously â€” a constant low-level tactical assessment of the environment. Smiles are rare and brief.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 practical: dark synthetic cargo pants with reinforced thigh pockets (medical supply storage), fitted tactical undershirt with moisture-wicking tech, oversized weatherproof jacket with interior armor plating (visible when jacket moves). Boots are heavy-duty combat-rated with grip-soles. A surgical satchel is constant â€” real leather, old, scarred from use. Minimal jewelry beyond a worn titanium med-alert bracelet. Everything is maintained obsessively, nothing is decorative.
